svg.title: Flow-volume loop patterns
svg.desc: Six simulated flow-volume loops, each drawn over a dashed normal loop for comparison: normal; obstructive with a low peak and a scooped expiratory limb; restrictive, narrow but normal in shape; fixed upper-airway obstruction with both limbs flattened; variable extrathoracic obstruction with only the inspiratory limb flattened; and variable intrathoracic obstruction with only the expiratory limb flattened.

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Flow up, volume breathed out to the right. Dashed: a normal loop. Simulated curves.
